description: A stunning off-plan five-bedroom townhouse with service quarters on Bourdillon Road, Ikoyi. Spanning six intelligent floors, the home features a striking futuristic façade, an elevator, private swimming pool, cinema, family lounge, rooftop jacuzzi, sauna, and gym. Estimated completion is December 2027.

rooms.heading: Ground & Lower Floors
rooms.body: The ground floor features parking, an entrance lobby, and the service quarters. The first floor hosts the primary living and dining areas with an open-plan kitchen.

rooms.heading: Upper Floors & Rooftop
rooms.body: The second, third, and fourth floors contain the en-suite bedrooms and family lounges. The fifth floor is dedicated to the master suite. The rooftop features a private jacuzzi, gym, sauna, and terrace.

description: A stunning modern residence on a 515.66m² plot in Banana Island. Designed with an emphasis on flow and connection, the home features a double-height living room, a private pool, and extensive terraces.

rooms.heading: Ground & First Floor
rooms.body: The ground floor hosts a 108m² living room, open kitchen, and guest suite. The first floor features a 20m² pool, home cinema, and gym.

rooms.heading: Upper Floors
rooms.body: The second floor contains the family lounge and secondary bedrooms. The pent floor is a dedicated master suite with a private lounge, spa, sauna, and a 37m² porch.

address: Plot D10(A), Banana Island Foreshore Estate
description: A monumental multi-level villa occupying a prime plot off Onikoyi Road. The architecture utilizes striking geometric facades, extensive glass, and integrated green spaces.

rooms.heading: Ground & First Floor
rooms.body: The ground floor features a vast living room, dining area, wet and dry kitchens, and a wrap-around water fountain. The first floor offers a secondary living space and outdoor pool.

rooms.heading: Upper Quarters
rooms.body: The second floor includes a private lounge, gym, and multiple bedrooms. The third floor is dedicated to the 'Madams Room' and the Master Bedroom with a large outdoor area.

description: A commanding residence on one of Ikoyi's most established streets. Designed for principals who expect discretion without compromise, the home balances generous entertaining space with private family quarters. Floor-to-ceiling glazing frames the mature gardens, while the interior architecture favours restraint — stone, warm timber, and considered light.

rooms.heading: The Residence
rooms.body: Five bedroom suites arranged across two floors, each with private bathing and dressing rooms. A double-height reception hall anchors the ground floor.

rooms.heading: Principal Rooms
rooms.body: Formal drawing room, a panelled study, a chef's kitchen with adjoining scullery, and a covered terrace overlooking the pool and grounds.

address: Tower Two, Eko Atlantic, Victoria Island
description: A full-floor apartment in the commercial and residential heart of Lagos. Panoramic views span the Atlantic and the marina below. The layout is engineered for entertaining at scale, with seamless flow between the reception rooms and a wraparound terrace.

rooms.heading: The Residence
rooms.body: Four bedroom suites, a media room, and staff accommodation, all served by a private lift lobby.

rooms.heading: Principal Rooms
rooms.body: Open-plan reception, a formal dining room for twelve, and a show kitchen finished in stone and brushed brass.

description: Exclusive waterfront living at its finest. This landmark home occupies a rare double plot with direct lagoon frontage, a private jetty, and grounds designed by an internationally recognised landscape studio. Every principal room opens to water.

rooms.heading: The Residence
rooms.body: Six bedroom suites, a wellness wing with pool and spa, and a self-contained guest pavilion.

rooms.heading: Principal Rooms
rooms.body: Waterfront drawing room, a cinema, a temperature-controlled cellar, and an entertainer's terrace with an outdoor kitchen.

description: A discreet villa within the gated calm of Parkview Estate. Recently reimagined, the home pairs a classical envelope with a fully contemporary interior. Ideal for a principal seeking a turnkey residence with mature privacy and immediate presence.

rooms.heading: The Residence
rooms.body: Four bedroom suites, a family lounge, and a home office positioned for quiet.

rooms.heading: Principal Rooms
rooms.body: Reception room, dining room, and a kitchen opening to a landscaped courtyard and pool.

description: A refined lease residence on one of Ikoyi's most prestigious residential streets. The house has been freshly updated, with a new kitchen, restored herringbone floors, and a landscaped rear garden with a pool terrace.

rooms.heading: The Residence
rooms.body: Four bedroom suites, formal drawing room, and a separate family wing with a media lounge.

rooms.heading: Principal Rooms
rooms.body: Dining room for ten, a chef's kitchen, and a study opening onto the garden.

description: A boutique waterfront apartment with direct views of the marina and the Five Cowrie Creek. The interior is finished in a light palette of oak and stone, with generous balconies off every reception room.

rooms.heading: The Residence
rooms.body: Three bedroom suites, an open-plan reception, and a separate utility and staff area.

rooms.heading: Principal Rooms
rooms.body: Living/dining room with a show kitchen, plus a master suite with a private terrace.

description: A landmark estate with two private residences on a single gated site. The compound includes a tennis court, a private dock, formal gardens, and separate guest and staff quarters.

rooms.heading: The Residence
rooms.body: Seven bedroom suites across two buildings, each with its own reception and kitchen facilities.

rooms.heading: Principal Rooms
rooms.body: Grand reception hall, formal dining room, two studies, a wine cellar, and a cinema.

description: A classic Ikoyi residence with a strong architectural presence and mature grounds. The home has been carefully modernised while keeping its original scale and proportion.

rooms.heading: The Residence
rooms.body: Five bedroom suites, a formal lounge, a family kitchen, and a separate guest suite.

rooms.heading: Principal Rooms
rooms.body: Double-height reception, dining room, library, and an outdoor loggia beside the pool.

description: A full-floor apartment in the Marina District with panoramic Atlantic views and 24-hour concierge. The building is designed for contemporary waterfront living.

rooms.heading: The Residence
rooms.body: Four bedroom suites, a private lift lobby, and a media room.

rooms.heading: Principal Rooms
rooms.body: Open-plan reception, a chef's kitchen, and a wraparound terrace facing the ocean.

description: A high-floor penthouse on Admiralty Way with skyline views and private rooftop access. The finish is contemporary and move-in ready.

rooms.heading: The Residence
rooms.body: Three bedroom suites, a private study, and an open-plan living area.

rooms.heading: Principal Rooms
rooms.body: Living room, dining room, and a designer kitchen with a private rooftop terrace.

description: A turnkey lease home in the commercial heart of Victoria Island. The property is suitable for a diplomatic residence or corporate executive let.

rooms.heading: The Residence
rooms.body: Four bedroom suites, a family lounge, and a home office with a separate entrance.

rooms.heading: Principal Rooms
rooms.body: Reception room, dining room, and a kitchen opening to a courtyard with a pool.

description: A spacious family villa with a generous garden, a swimming pool, and off-street parking for several cars. The layout is practical and designed for entertaining.

rooms.heading: The Residence
rooms.body: Five bedroom suites, a family lounge, and a separate boys' quarters.

rooms.heading: Principal Rooms
rooms.body: Formal living room, dining room, kitchen, and a covered terrace by the pool.
